title: A sim lease expires only when its holder's pid is gone.
ruling: Coordinator design pick, 08:38 CST Nov 12 (not an owner ruling): a lease expires only when its holder's pid is gone, so a live silent run never loses its phone. Fix from round 1 review of PR #2787.
